svg.text: How pplx-decider controls the All-merged agent through JevAgentHarness (branch dm_harness)
Each arm aligns all 299,961 classes: every class with a reference partner plus the complete SNOMED CT → ICD-11 map. Nothing is held out. The calibration sample of arm C is
also aligned and scored. Score: Top-k (k = 1, 3, 5) on the 270,290 classes that have a reference partner. Compared with All merged and All merged + agent from oa-rlaif-full-eval-results (read only).

Arm C then aligns all 299,961 classes with the frozen τ (the sample included). Table 11 also scores it without the sample.
3 · The three confidence scores and when they act
pplx-decider's probability that the next agent step
Acts: Strong tier (thinking ON) when p(hard) ≥ τ_r
probability of the most likely candidate (NONE
Acts: Redo on the strong tier with the hint when p(best) ≥ τ_g
probability of pplx-decider's own pick in arm A
Acts: pplx-decider answers alone when confidence ≥ τ_c
B: not used (Table 8: what-if) · C: fitted

ΔC = the GPU cost of one agent step (the machine's price per hour ÷ 3,600 ÷ steps per second, measured in arm B). V = $1 per wrong class. right(·) = 1 if the first answer is a reference partner, else 0.
4 · Reading τ* off the bins (illustration, not measured data)
Bins sorted by score (low → high). Scan from the top bin down:
• bin 5 is negative → stop. τ* = where bin 6 starts.
Bin 4 is positive, but it is below a losing bin, so it does not act.
If the top bin were negative: no τ, the decision is never made.
Scoring (DRAL-OA clf.py), per scored class c, F_c = top k answers, R_c = partners:
Averaged over classes; F@k = 2·P·R / (P + R); k = 1, 3, 5.
